title: Stamp the dispatching feature into job.json and read it first in the activity hook and bee close
action: Follow the Contract in docs/history/herding-job-feature/plan.md. The job feature has one home, job.json feature. bee herding run takes --feature and stamps feature into every job.json it writes (resolution: --feature, then the --cell-id cell feature, then the calling session bound lane, else no key). bee dispatch prepare adds --feature "<slug>" to every herding run command it returns when it resolved a feature. hooks/activity.rs resolve_herded_feature reads job.json feature first. verbs/drivers/close.rs herding_jobs takes the feature from job.json first, then activity.json. Old jobs without the key keep the old behavior. Update help text in generated/registry_payload.json and the close-usage-record concept (cite docs/history/herding-job-feature/plan.md, no raw decision ids). Write tests first and watch them fail.

truths: A main-cwd job stamped with feature X while state.json says Y is labelled X and counted by bee close X, not Y
Every herding run command bee dispatch prepare returns carries --feature when a feature resolved
herding run stamps job.json feature from --feature and from the cell
A job.json without feature keeps the old fallback
